jobs.title: Legal Counsel - Libyan Law Specialist
jobs.description:
Dentons is designed to be different. We are driven to always be the firm of the future, to challenge the status quo, and to provide holistic business solutions to our clients in new and innovative ways. We are the lightbulb moments. The bold ideas. We are the world's largest global law firm, with 12,000+ people across 80+ countries. Driven by the diverse perspectives of our people, our clients, and our communities, we combine local knowledge with global insight.

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Legal Counsel with expertise in Libyan law to join our legal team in Tunis, Tunisia. The successful candidate will play a key role in advising on legal matters involving Libyan jurisdictions, supporting cross-border operations, and ensuring regulatory compliance. This role requires deep knowledge of the Libyan legal system, high professional standards, and a strong ability to operate in a multi-jurisdictional and multicultural environment.

Responsibilities

  • Provide accurate and timely legal advice on matters governed by Libyan law, including civil, commercial, administrative, and labor law.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate a variety of legal instruments such as contracts, MoUs, joint venture agreements, partnership agreements, and compliance documentation.
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments in Libya, interpret their implications, and advise internal stakeholders accordingly.
  • Liaise effectively between Tunis-based operations and Libyan clients, authorities, and counterparties, ensuring transparent and culturally appropriate communication.
  • Support interactions with Libyan ministries, regulatory authorities, licensing bodies, and legal institutions.
  • Assist in mitigating legal risks, managing disputes, and supporting internal compliance processes aligned with both Libyan and Tunisian regulations.
  • Contribute to internal training and awareness sessions related to Libyan legal frameworks.

The Fine Dining Restaurant Managers will lead the front-of-house operation of a premium, ever-evolving dining concepts, delivering an exceptional guest experience within a dynamic seasonal destination. The role requires a strong understanding of luxury hospitality, refined service standards, and the ability to adapt to a concept centred around Mediterranean / Greek cuisine.

The successful candidate will be a confident and inspiring leader, responsible for driving service excellence, developing high-performing teams, and ensuring every aspect of the guest journey reflects the highest standards of quality, sophistication, and hospitality.

  • Oversee day-to-day operations to ensure a seamless, elegant, and refined dining experience.
  • Maintain high standards for food quality, presentation, authenticity, and menu consistency, with special emphasis on traditional and upscale Lebanese dishes.
  • Ensure strict compliance with food safety, hygiene, and fine dining service protocols.
  • Coordinate with the Executive Chef on menu development, seasonal offerings, and premium Lebanese ingredients.
  • Manage inventory of specialty Middle Eastern ingredients, wines, and premium products.

  • Lead by example with a strong, positive leadership style that inspires professionalism and excellence.
  • Recruit, train, and mentor front-of-house and back-of-house staff in fine dining etiquette, Lebanese culinary knowledge, and guest-focused service.
  • Conduct regular performance evaluations and coaching sessions to maintain a high-performing team.
  • Foster a respectful, motivated, and service-oriented culture.
  • Ensure staff adhere to refined table service techniques, wine pairing standards, and cultural hospitality practices.

3. Guest Experience and Hospitality

  • Create a warm, welcoming, and culturally rich atmosphere that reflects the spirit of Lebanese hospitality.
  • Engage with guests to ensure exceptional service, personal attention, and elegant problem resolution.
  • Handle VIP reservations, special occasions, and premium guest experiences with care and discretion.
  • Address guest concerns promptly and professionally to maintain an elevated dining reputation.

4. Financial & Administrative Management

  • Oversee budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting to ensure profitability.
  • Monitor food, beverage, and labor costs while maintaining fine dining quality standards.
  • Negotiate with premium suppliers of Lebanese wines, spices, meats, and specialty products.
  • Manage POS systems, payroll, scheduling, and vendor invoicing.

5. Marketing & Brand Representation

  • Support marketing initiatives that highlight upscale Lebanese cuisine, cultural dining experiences, and seasonal menus.
  • Maintain strong online and community presence, including reputation management on review platforms.
  • Plan and oversee special events such as Lebanese wine tastings, cultural nights, and chef’s table experiences.
